title: Austin Rief: The Morning Brew CEO | The Danny Miranda Podcast 302
description:
Austin Rief is the cofounder and CEO of Morning Brew - a daily newsletter with over 4 million subscribers. 

In this conversation, Austin spoke about his content diet, who he admires, the one podcast everyone needs to listen to if they’re creating a startup, why he’s taking Twitter seriously in 2023, and much more.
